paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: ATLAS light-by-light scattering search in Pb+Pb collisions sets 95% CL limits on ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda_a for masses 6-100 GeV. The limit is reported as 1/Lambda_a ranging from 0.3 TeV^-1 (at low mass) to 0.06 TeV^-1, where 1/Lambda_a corresponds to g_agamma (in GeV^-1, i.e. 0.3 TeV^-1 = 3e-4 GeV^-1, 0.06 TeV^-1 = 6e-5 GeV^-1). However, no per-mass numerical data table is given in the text (only a plot, Figure 9/10). Specific (mass, coupling) pairs cannot be reliably extracted from the text/figures provided, so data_points left empty. This is a collider/ALP production bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed.
